role: Development-only action-aligned audit; no router fitting, test access, or API calls.
population: The same 419 tasks and 6285 frozen outcomes used by E1.
stable_switch_definition: candidate exceeds anchor by more than 0.05 in at least two of three repeats
cross_repeat_policy: For each held repeat, switch only when candidate mean advantage on the other two repeats exceeds 0.05; evaluate gain and harm on the held repeat.
harmful_switch_definition: A selected switch whose held-repeat candidate quality is more than 0.05 below anchor.
overall_gate: At least one specialist passes every per-specialist condition.
pass_action: Freeze anchor plus passing specialists and construct three-level switch labels.
failure_action: Stop router fitting and repair evaluation granularity or candidate specialization.
